baseline.limitations: Fails to capture non-linear sector thresholds, complex interactions, and extreme tail risk

ml_ensemble.advantages: Captures non-linear bottlenecks, ministry-sector interaction effects, robust classification
ml_ensemble.key_takeaway: Provides 76.8% risk-category classification accuracy, superior early-warning triage for critical projects

model_a_cuf_only.description: Trained strictly on existing Common Upload Form (CUF) static parameters

model_b_cuf_plus_engineered.description: Includes dynamic progress tracking and expenditure-to-progress burn ratio

ablation_study.policy_recommendation: MoSPI should mandate capturing physical milestone velocity and contractor performance scores inside PAIMANA CUF
